title: Rav Acha, Son of Rav Ami
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yoma 84a and Zevachim 60b. Hyman calls both readings textual errors. Yoma should read Rav Acha, son of Rava, as in the parallel in Avodah Zarah 28a; Seder HaDorot gives 88a, which Hyman corrects to 28a. Dikdukei Soferim likewise has this reading at Yoma 84a. Zevachim should read Rav Acharvoi bar Ami, as in Shitah Mekubetzet and Dikdukei Soferim.

notes.text: The works are distinct: Seder HaDorot gives the mistaken 88a reference; Dikdukei Soferim supports Hyman’s name readings.

The consulted Yoma 84a reads Acha son of Rav Ami, while Avodah Zarah 28a has Acha son of Rava in the parallel remedy. The exact Dikdukei Soferim and Shitah Mekubetzet readings, and Seder HaDorot’s printed locator, were not independently inspected; they remain Hyman’s report.
